name: macspeak
description: Reads a 1-3 sentence summary of each finished Claude Code reply aloud with the Mac's built-in voice (say), one voice at a time across sessions

voice.title: Mac voice
voice.description: A name from `say -v '?'`, e.g. Karen, Daniel, Samantha. Empty uses the system voice. /speak voice <name> overrides it.

rate.title: Speaking rate
rate.description: Words per minute (about 175-220 is natural). Empty uses the system rate. /speak rate <n> overrides it.

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: Small fast model that turns a long reply into 1-3 spoken sentences
